limitations.note: The patch fixed the reset loop but also made enabled out-of-range reads hold the previous output instead of returning the unknown value produced by the original and reference implementations.

The test expected the previous output during an enabled read of address 8, so it validated the patch’s new out-of-range behavior rather than detecting the regression, although its reset checks did exercise the actual defect.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The first simulation command was rejected before it ran because of its cleanup command, so the agent had to resubmit the test using a temporary-directory helper.
